text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm planning a small API contract change on /v1/generate. Intend to add a `metadata.model_version` field in the response envelope and deprecate the `model_pin` query param in favor of an `Accept-Model` request header. Proposal: support both for 3 months, auto-shim server-side mapping from `model_pin` -> `Accept-Model`, and then remove `model_pin`. Wanted to check SDK impact and rollout ops. pinging @sophie @maria @vikram :wave:
maria: thanks for the ping. can you paste the exact response delta you expect? will break any strict JSON schemas?

alex: sure — example: 
```
// old
{
  "response": { "text": "..." },
  "model_pin": "redwood-1.2"
}
// new
{
  "response": { "text": "..." },
  "metadata": { "model_version": "redwood-1.2", "inferred_from": "model_pin_shim" }
}
```
we'd still include `model_pin` while shim is active, but mark it `deprecated: true` in docs. server shim: if `model_pin` present => treat like `Accept-Model` header.

vikram: server shim sounds fine. a couple Qs: 1) what about routing & fallback? if header absent but model_pin present we keep exact semantics? 2) need to ensure cache keys include model version to avoid poisoning.

alex: good points. planned semantics: shim = exact mapping (no widening). routing unchanged. cache key will include the resolved model id. we'll add a warning log when shim used.

sophie: from SDK perspective we prefer server-side shim for short window. but we'll also ship client change to prefer `Accept-Model` header in next minor. can you add a short API compatibility test so SDKs can detect shim behavior? e.g., call with `model_pin=test-x` and assert header received on server-side traces.

maria: +1 for a canary rollout. Suggested timeline: 2w canary on staging/preview, 6w gradual ramp in prod with metrics and a rollback window, full removal at 3 months. Also: add a feature flag toggle `api.model_pin_shim.enabled` for 1-click rollback.

alex: timeline sounds reasonable. I'll create the rollout PR with feature-flag and infra changes. For docs: propose a deprecation notice in the newsletter + SDK changelogs.

vikram: metrics to watch: 1) % of requests using `model_pin` after release, 2) error surge 4xx/5xx on generate, 3) cache hit-rate variance. set alert if `model_pin` usage > 5% after 6w.

sophie: I'll add compatibility test + e2e in SDK CI that runs against preview canary. also need migration docs for customers showing `model_pin` -> `Accept-Model` mapping and sample curl snippet.

alex: draft curl snippet for docs: 
```
curl -H "Accept-Model: redwood-1.2" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"..."}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag branch will be deployed to preview at 2026-04-02T03:00Z. Canary window: 2026-04-02 -> 2026-04-16.

alex: perfect. action items: (1) i'll open the server PR with shim + flag + warning logs, (2) @sophie add SDK test + client header change plan, (3) @maria set canary and alerts, (4) @vikram add cache-key and routing review in PR. i'll also post deprecation doc and timeline once PR merges. thanks all :thumbsup:
